title: Entropic Collapse and Extreme First-Passage Times in Discrete Ballistic Transport
summary: We investigate the extreme first-passage statistics of $N$ non-interacting random walkers on discrete, hierarchical networks. {By distinguishing between transport limited by escape from localized initial states (injection-limited) and transport limited by the extended network (bulk-limited), we identify a class of extreme value statistics that arises in geometries dominated by source traps (e.g., the Comet graph).} In this regime, the distribution of the minimum arrival time does not converge to any of the classical generalized extreme value distributions.
